title: Wolfpixel SEO Case Study: 500+ Keywords & 5–10 Monthly Call Bookings
outcome: From zero to 500+ relevant ranking keywords, with 5–10 potential call bookings per month reported by Shobon.
summary: From joining Wolfpixel in April 2025 to leading its SEO team: a three-month focus on the agency’s own search visibility and buying-intent service pages.
timeline: Joined 12 April 2025 · Three-month website growth phase
situation: I joined Wolfpixel on 12 April 2025, learned SEO under Khondokar Asiful Islam and worked on SEO for multiple agency clients.
challenge: Turn organic discovery into relevant enquiries for Wolfpixel’s own services.
takeaway: Relevant visibility matters most when it connects potential buyers with services and a conversation.

title: America’s Medicare Associates SEO Case Study: 121% Reported Growth
outcome: 121% online growth reported by Shobon across the engagement.
summary: Trusted with a second project after ARHQ, I partnered with AMA on digital growth through SEO, connecting service content, technical foundations and local discovery.
situation: America’s Medicare Associates came to me through the client behind my ARHQ engagement. They were happy with my work and asked me to take on this Medicare project as well. We started working together in October 2025.

takeaway: Trust earned through ARHQ led to another engagement. Each business still starts with its own diagnosis.

title: Retirement Tax Partners SEO Case Study: 83% Reported Online Growth
outcome: 83% online growth reported by Shobon across the engagement.
summary: As RTP’s Digital Growth Partner, I used SEO to build digital growth around a new website: diagnose first, then connect technical, on-page, off-page and content work.
situation: When Retirement Tax Partners came to me in August 2025, they had a completely new website. What they needed next was a way for the right people to find it. The brief was about building an online presence that could support the business, rather than simply getting a website online.
challenge: Build relevant organic discovery for a completely new retirement tax website.
takeaway: Start with a conversation and a complete diagnosis. Connect the SEO work to the services people actually need.

title: ARHQ: connecting a domain transition with 67% reported online growth
outcome: 67% online growth reported by Shobon across the engagement.
summary: As ARHQ’s Digital Growth Partner, I used SEO to support a domain transition and digital growth, connecting technical foundations, useful content and local discovery.
situation: ARHQ needed to move away from an older domain while building organic visibility in the locations it serves. The work began in July 2025 with a conversation about that transition and the growth the business needed from its website.
challenge: The central challenge was making a website change support growth. A new domain and a new site can interrupt discovery if the search strategy, content and technical foundations are treated as separate projects.
takeaway: A website transition is also a growth decision. Diagnosis comes first; technical work, useful content and location relevance need a shared direction.
